request.style: English, jazz, warm female solo voice with soft choir, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, upright bass, mood of joyful reverence, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I rejoiced when they said to me
Let us go to the house of the LORD
My heart is light with this simple plea
To walk where His presence is adored

[Chorus]
Our feet are standing in your gates
Jerusalem built as a city bound
The tribes go up in holy states
To give thanks to the name of the Lord

[Verse]
A song of ascents, a song of David
Called to the place of His dwelling
The tribes of the LORD are having
Their joyful gathering in the living light

[Chorus]
Our feet are standing in your gates
Jerusalem built as a city bound
The tribes go up in holy states
To give thanks to the name of the Lord

[Bridge]
As a decree for Israel stands
To praise the name of the Lord
Our feet are steady on the sands
In the house of the Lord

[Outro]
Let us go to the house of the LORD
Our feet are standing in your gates
